description: This file defines a Spring MVC Controller named CacheController, which handles cache management functionalities such as displaying cache keys and clearing cache entries within an admin interface.

classes.name: CacheController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for cache management, providing endpoints for displaying cache keys and clearing cache entries.

methods.name: displayAccounts
methods.description: Handles GET request for cache management page, retrieves cache keys for the store, and populates the model.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Handles POST request to clear specific cache entries or all cache for a store, returning JSON response.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu data for the view, setting active menu and current menu in the model.
